title: Signs of a hardware problem and when to stop pushing

videos.script: The last lesson was a method with no facts in it. This one is the facts: what a failing machine actually does, part by part, and which of those means stop now. {{facts}} Hardware faults are worth a lesson of their own for one reason. Almost all of them imitate software — a slow machine, a crash, a program that will not open — so they are diagnosed as software for weeks, while the thing that is actually failing gets worse. {{imitate}} Heat, the disk, the memory, the power and the screen. Each one has a signature, and three of them have a symptom that means put it down and copy your files off before anything else. {{five}} That is the part of this lesson worth remembering if nothing else does: the difference between a machine that is broken and a machine that is about to take your work with it.
